title: Owner drags a technician column to a new position on Board View and the order persists
custom_preconds:
Signed in as Admin, viewport at least 1280 px wide.
Saved Work Orders view reset over the API (display List, no layout keys). No technician order and no pins saved.
At least three eligible technicians.

custom_steps_separated.content: Open Work Orders and pick Board View.
custom_steps_separated.expected: Note the first two technician columns, P then Q.

custom_steps_separated.content: Drag Q's column handle to before P and release.
custom_steps_separated.expected: A drop indicator shows; then Q leads and P follows, and no toast shows.

custom_steps_separated.content: Once the preference is saved, reload the page cold.
custom_steps_separated.expected: Board View reopens with Q then P leading the technician columns.
